body.html: The number-one selling point of Kavinburi Green Hotel is its location · The hotel sits on Prajak Sillapakhom Road, Mak Khaeng, in the UD Town area of central Udon · It is just about 360m from Udon Thani Train Station, an easy walk with a suitcase · UD Town, the city's popular night market, and Central Plaza are both about a 5-minute walk away · Restaurants, convenience stores and the bus station are all within walking distance — for anyone arriving in Udon without a car, this is a hard location to beat at this price.

There are around 70 rooms, split into Superior and Suite categories · Rooms are decorated in a clean, contemporary style with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, minibar and safe, and some have a balcony · The honest caveat is that rooms are fairly small — many reviews say they suit one or two guests rather than a big family · Guests praise the comfortable beds and the cleanliness in well-kept rooms · That said, some reviews report a musty smell or mildew in the bathroom and fridges that don't always work — a sign the building is starting to show its age and that housekeeping isn't perfectly consistent across every room.

"The staff were lovely and the location is unbeatable — we walked straight from the train station, and UD Town and Central were just a few minutes away. Going up to the rooftop sky bar in the evening gave us a nice city view, and breakfast had a decent spread for the price."

The feature that sets Kavinburi apart from similarly priced hotels is its rooftop swimming pool with a sky bar · In the evening it's a pleasant spot for a drink with a view over Udon, and many reviews single it out · There is also a fitness centre, a restaurant, and — notably for this price tier — a free airport shuttle · The buffet breakfast is served from around 6:30 AM with bread, eggs, fruit and Thai dishes; most reviews call it solid for the price, even if the variety is not huge.

Straight talk: Kavinburi Green Hotel suits travellers who put location and price ahead of luxury · It scores 8.9 from 151 reviews on Trip.com and 4.0 stars on TripAdvisor (#2 of 47 specialty lodging options in Udon), which reflects broadly happy guests · But there are trade-offs that recur in the reviews · The building and the rooftop decking are starting to age, with some boards warped or missing · Hot water runs on a solar system, so it can be inconsistent at times · And the Wi-Fi requires repeated logins, which is annoying if you work online · If you can look past these, the location and price are very good value.

A tip from following the reviews: because rooms are small and not all equally maintained, ask for a recently refurbished room or a higher floor with a balcony when you book, and check the bathroom for any musty smell at check-in · If the water isn't hot early in the morning, let the front desk know, as the solar system takes time · Standard Superior rates sit around ฿1,000–฿1,400/night, rising over the cool season (Dec–Feb), which is the Isan high season — compare a few platforms and book a free-cancellation rate to be safe.

honestSummary: Kavinburi Green Hotel sells a walk-to-the-train-station location near UD Town and Central, plus a rooftop pool and sky bar at a 3-star price — ideal for travellers arriving in Udon without a car who want value · The trade-offs are small rooms, an aging building and housekeeping that isn't consistent across every room.
honestChecks: If you're a big family or want a spacious room — rooms here are fairly small and suit one or two guests → pick a Suite or look at a hotel with larger rooms if you need the space.
If you need to work online seriously from the room — Wi-Fi requires repeated logins and can be inconsistent → bring a backup mobile data package.
If you're particular about newness and upkeep — the building and rooftop decking are aging, and some rooms can be musty → ask for a recently refurbished room when you book and check it at check-in.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Kavinburi Green Hotel Udon Thani

faq.q: Where is Kavinburi Green Hotel and how do I get there?
faq.a: It is at 299/99 Prajak Sillapakhom Road, Mak Khaeng, in the UD Town area of central Udon Thani · It is just about 360m from Udon Thani Train Station, an easy walk with a suitcase · UD Town and Central Plaza are both about a 5-minute walk · Udon Thani Airport (UTH) is around 15 minutes by car, and there is a free airport shuttle plus free parking.

faq.q: How much does Kavinburi Green Hotel cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start at approximately ฿1,000/night for a Superior · A Superior with a balcony runs around ฿1,300, and a Suite from around ฿1,800 · Prices vary by season and package, rising over the cool season (Dec–Feb), so compare a few platforms before booking · Breakfast and the airport shuttle are included in many packages.

faq.q: Does Kavinburi Green Hotel have a pool?
faq.a: Yes — a rooftop swimming pool with a sky bar · In the evening it's a nice spot for a drink with a view over Udon, a feature you don't usually get at this price tier · The caveat is that the rooftop decking is aging, with some boards warped or missing, so watch your step · There is also a fitness centre and a restaurant.

faq.q: What are the rooms like and who is the hotel best for?
faq.a: Rooms are decorated in a clean, contemporary style with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, minibar and safe, and some have a balcony · Rooms are fairly small and suit one or two guests rather than a big family · The hotel is best for travellers arriving in Udon without a car who want a walk-everywhere location and good value · If you want a spacious room, pick a Suite or look elsewhere.

faq.q: Anything to know before booking Kavinburi Green Hotel?
faq.a: The things to know are that the building and rooftop decking are aging, hot water runs on a solar system and can be inconsistent at times, and the Wi-Fi requires repeated logins · Some rooms can be musty or have a fridge that doesn't work well · Ask for a recently refurbished room when you book and check it at check-in · Rooms fill fast in the cool season, so book ahead and choose a free-cancellation rate to be safe.
